description: Create, assign, track, and complete project-management tasks with status, priority, due dates, and subtasks in a JSON-backed store.
name: pm_task
provider_notes: Local JSON-backed store via ctx.memory (key aul:pm_tasks_v1). No external PM provider integrated; an Asana/Linear/Jira connector would sit behind ctx.auth_get('pm'). Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
